title.narrative: Progr. de Agua Potable y Alcantarillado
Water and Sewer Program

description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa es fomentar y consolidar un proceso de reforma del sector de recursos hdricos y del subsector agua potable y saneamiento, a fin de: (i) promover la conservacin y el suso ms racional y eficiente del recurso hdrico; y (ii) crear un ambiente institucional y empresarial favorable para la inversin pblica y privada en servicios de agua potable y saneamiento.Especficamente, se espera reestructurar los mecanismos de gestin en el sector y el subsector a travs de: (i) la creacin de una autoridad hdrica financieramente independiente desarrollando las funciones rectoras y poltica para el buen aprovechamiento y conservacin del recurso hdrico, dotada de capacidad tcnica, estudios e instrumentos adecuados para el manejo integral del recurso y la asignacin racional de derechos de uso de agua; (ii) la creacin de un marco regulatorio del subsector agua potable y saneamiento y un ente regulador independiente y financieramente autnomo dotado de instrumentos adecuados para garantizar el cumplimiento de las reglamentaciones que se dicte en lo relativo a la provisin de servicios, facilitando y promoviendo la competencia y transparencia en todos los niveles de prestacin de servicios de agua potable y alcantarillado, pblicos, privados y mixtos, ms eficientes, financieramente viables y con programas de expansin y mejoras de calidad de servicio.

The general objective of the programme is to promote and consolidate a process of reforming the water sector and subsector of drinking water and sanitation, in order: (i) promote conservation and its most rational and efficient water resources, and (ii) to create an institutional environment conducive to business and public and private investment in drinking water and sanitation. Specifically, it is expected to restructure the management mechanisms in the sector and subsector through: (i) creation of a financially independent water authority to develop the leadership and policy for the proper utilization and conservation of water resources, with technical capacity, studies and appropriate tools for integrated management of the resource and rational allocation of water use rights, (ii) the creation of a regulatory framework of drinking water and sanitation subsector and a regulator independent and financially autonomous equipped with adequate instruments to ensure fulfillment with the regulations that were issued as regards the provision of services by facilitating and promoting competition and transparency at all levels of provision of potable water and sewerage, public, private and mixed, more efficient, financially viable and expansion programmes and improvements in service quality.
